001package services;
002
003import base.User;
004import enums.Role;
005import models.Message;
006
007import java.util.ArrayList;
008import java.util.Collections;
009import java.util.List;
010
011/** Direct messages and complaints routed to managers or admins. */
012public class MessageService {
013    private static MessageService instance;
014    private final Database db = Database.getInstance();
015
016    private MessageService() {}
017
018    public static MessageService getInstance() {
019        if (instance == null) instance = new MessageService();
020        return instance;
021    }
022
023    public void sendMessage(User from, User to, String subject, String body) {
024        if (from == null || to == null) return;
025        String text = format(subject, body);
026        to.receiveMessage(new Message(from.getLogin(), text));
027        db.save();
028    }
029
030    public void sendComplaint(User from, String body) {
031        if (from == null) return;
032        List<User> managers = db.getUsersByRole(Role.MANAGER);
033        if (managers.isEmpty()) {
034            // fallback: send to admins if no managers exist
035            managers = db.getUsersByRole(Role.ADMIN);
036        }
037        for (User manager : managers) {
038            sendMessage(from, manager, "Complaint", body);
039        }
040    }
041
042    public List<Message> getInbox(User of) {
043        if (of == null) return Collections.emptyList();
044        return new ArrayList<>(of.getMessages());
045    }
046
047    private String format(String subject, String body) {
048        String s = subject == null ? "" : subject.trim();
049        String b = body == null ? "" : body.trim();
050        if (s.isEmpty()) return b;
051        if (b.isEmpty()) return s;
052        return s + " — " + b;
053    }
054}
055
